purpose: Define a read-only Expose monitor for change records, subscriptions, cursors, snapshot-stream handoff, emitted Events, lag/backpressure and replay/failure state.

owns: DWH Changefeed and CDC Monitor semantics

topics.name: DWH Changefeed and CDC Monitor
topics.purpose: Define a read-only Expose monitor for change records, subscriptions, cursors, snapshot-stream handoff, emitted Events, lag/backpressure and replay/failure state.

semantics.identity_rule: Record, revision, change record, subscription, cursor, Event and delivery/replay identities remain distinct.
semantics.authority_rule: Viewing CDC state grants no source mutation or downstream execution authority.
semantics.action_rule: create/pause/resume/replay/resnapshot/close subscription operations invoke separate authorized canonical workflows.
semantics.graph_rule: Change→subscription→Event and snapshot→stream edges correspond only to explicit refs.
semantics.derived_rule: Lag/current/healthy status is derived runtime evidence and not source authority.
semantics.failure_rule: Gaps, overflow, failed Event emission and stale subscriptions are surfaced explicitly.

invariants.rule: DWH changefeeds expose committed mutation evidence as ordered provenance-bearing data/events; subscription delivery never directly executes downstream operations and never replaces the underlying record/revision identities.

hard_gates.condition: monitor conflates change and Event identity

prose.summary: Define a read-only Expose monitor for change records, subscriptions, cursors, snapshot-stream handoff, emitted Events, lag/backpressure and replay/failure state.
notes: Unlocked pending reconciliation against DWH mutation/persistence, Event causality, sync and remote-sharing contracts.
